language.label: Language
language.description: Interface language on this device. Data, model output and server messages that have no translation stay as sent.

errors.hostUnreachable: The Research OS host could not be reached.
errors.offline: Can't reach your Research OS computer. Check that it is on and on the same network.

apiErrors.aiBusy: another AI call is in progress; try again shortly
apiErrors.aiOutcomeUnknown: the AI call timed out and may have been billed; cost kept as 'unknown' until reconciled
apiErrors.aiOutputRejected: no allowed model produced a valid answer
apiErrors.badControl: a negative control runs at the trial stage only (never on the test set)
apiErrors.badDecision: stage, decision and a reason (>= 3 chars) are required
apiErrors.badDirection: direction must be references or cited_by
apiErrors.badMode: mode must be copy (default) or move
apiErrors.badPlanSubQuestions: plan needs 1-6 sub-questions, each with 1-3 queries
apiErrors.badProtocolFactors: factors must be 1-4 parameters of the plan's search space
apiErrors.badRootAccess: access must be read or write
apiErrors.badStatus: status must be confirmed or rejected
apiErrors.badSubjectImport: knowledge_import subject id must be the sha256 of the selected records
apiErrors.badSubjectPlan: plan subject id must look like '<plan_id>@<revision>'
apiErrors.badSuggestion: op replace|insert_after need an anchor; text must be non-empty
apiErrors.badTerm: every axis term needs at least one non-empty alternative
apiErrors.busy: an apply/undo for this plan is already queued or running
apiErrors.canaryUnavailable: built-in canary template missing or not reviewed
apiErrors.datasetChanged: same name+version with different content; bump the version
apiErrors.effectNotApprovedRemote: approve this exact plan first (re-auth on remote devices)
apiErrors.idempotencyKeyRequired: Idempotency-Key header required for this write
apiErrors.idempotencyMismatch: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body
apiErrors.importNotAuthorized: imports need an approval or a saved-search opt-in
apiErrors.invalidPairingCode: pairing code invalid, used or expired
apiErrors.invalidSavedSearch: kind=query needs query.text; kind=author needs query.author
apiErrors.missingDependency: numpy is required for datasets (install the experiments extra)
apiErrors.noCitationSource: no installed source supports citation chaining
apiErrors.noCitedSentences: this answer has no verified, cited sentences to insert
apiErrors.noRuns: this plan has no runs to bundle
apiErrors.notComparableData: runs used different datasets or splits
apiErrors.notComparableSeeds: runs used different seeds; compare configurations at the same seed
apiErrors.notComparableWindows: the runs' predictions cover different windows or labels
apiErrors.notEligible: include at title/abstract stage before full-text screening
apiErrors.notInReview: candidate is not part of this review
apiErrors.operationInProgress: This operation is running; retry the same key.
apiErrors.operationUncertain: Card field has no saved answer after interruption; inspect the gateway call before starting a new intent.
apiErrors.planNotApproved: approve the plan revision before starting a study
apiErrors.reauthRequired: re-enter your password to approve this from a remote device
apiErrors.setupLocalOnly: initial setup must be done on the host machine (127.0.0.1)
apiErrors.subjectChanged: the subject changed since you reviewed it; review again
apiErrors.tooManyAttempts: too many failed attempts; wait a few minutes
apiErrors.unknownLink: every link must name an existing record
apiErrors.versionConflict: document changed on server; both versions kept, merge required
apiErrors.monthlyBudget: monthly AI budget would be exceeded; paid call rejected
apiErrors.taskBudget: per-task AI budget would be exceeded
apiErrors.dailyBudget: today's AI budget would be exceeded; paid call rejected
apiErrors.projectBudget: per-project AI budget would be exceeded (or the call has no project)
apiErrors.pageNotFound: no parsed page with that index for this document version
apiErrors.quoteNotFound: the quote does not occur on that page of the source
apiErrors.internalError: internal error; see server log with correlation_id
apiErrors.idempotencyMismatchTask: Idempotency-Key reused for a different task

app.notFoundBody: Use the menu to get back.

app.hostSetupBody: The first account can only be created on the computer that runs Research OS. Then pair this device.

shell.queuedRejected: {{count}} queued action(s) were rejected by the host
shell.connectedTip: Connected to your Research OS host
shell.offlineTip: Host unreachable — showing saved data; actions are queued

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Shortcuts work anywhere except while typing.

state.savedCopy: Showing saved copy — the host can't be reached right now.

auth.setupDescription: Create the local admin account. This only works on the host computer.
auth.signInDescription: Sign in to your Research OS host.
auth.pairInstead: Pair this device with a code instead
auth.pairDescription: On your computer open Settings → Devices → Pair a device, then type the 8-character code here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.providersDescription: Keys are stored only on the host and are never shown again or sent to this browser. Without keys, AI features say “not configured”.
settings.hostDescription: The computer that stores your data and runs tasks.

devices.qrAlt: QR code with the pairing address
devices.noLan: No LAN address configured yet — see docs/OPS.md#ipad to enable HTTPS on your network.
devices.pairDescription: On the iPad, open the Research OS address, choose “Pair this device”, and enter this code.
devices.revokedToast: {{name}} can no longer access Research OS
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Browsers and iPads that can use this host.
devices.revokeDescription: It is signed out immediately and needs a new pairing code to come back.

projects.newDescription: A project holds your question, evidence, experiments and decisions.
projects.goalHint: What do you want to find out? You can refine it later.
projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Your research questions and everything attached to them.
projects.emptyBody: Start with one question you care about. Papers, notes and experiments will live inside it.

project.nextDescription: What you will do next on this project.
project.notesDescription: Drafts are kept on this device until saved.
project.noNotesBody: Capture questions and ideas as you read.
project.docsDescription: Exports pass the citation and number checks.

note.conflict: This note changed elsewhere. Both versions are kept — merge them below.
note.offlineSaved: Saved on this device only. It will sync when the host is reachable.
note.textPlaceholder: Write freely — drafts are kept on this device.

doc.acceptBlocked: Save or discard your unsaved edits first: accepting creates a new revision.

library.title: Library
library.description: Imported originals are stored read-only; parsing runs in the worker.
library.emptyBody: Import text PDFs. Scanned pages are flagged for OCR, never guessed.

evidence.chooseProject: Choose the project the document belongs to.
evidence.confirmCard: Create a {{what}}? This asks cited questions about this paper's full text through the model gateway (paid, within the ledger caps). Statements arrive as suggestions for you to accept.
evidence.badSourceYear: Enter a source and a year from 1900 to 2100.
evidence.badEntries: Entries must be a JSON array of objects with a tier and venue or ISSN.
evidence.confirmReplace: Replace the entire venue-tier table for {{source}}? Entries omitted here will be removed for this source.
evidence.title: Evidence labels
evidence.intro: Published does not verify peer review. Publication and retraction labels cannot be manually edited with the current API.
evidence.projectField: Project for paper cards and checklists
evidence.replaceIntro: Applies to all matching works. Provide the complete table for this source; tiers are never inferred.

research.title: Research
research.description: Answers come only from your library; every sentence links to its source page.
research.placeholder: Ask a question about your documents

tasks.stopRunning: The worker will stop it at the next safe point. Results so far are kept.
tasks.selfTestQueued: Self-test queued: the worker should pick it up within seconds
tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Everything the worker runs: imports, experiments, maintenance.
tasks.workerDown: The worker is not running: queued tasks wait, and "running" tasks are not progressing. Start it with start.ps1.
tasks.emptyBody: Imports and experiments appear here with their real status.

literature.title: Literature
literature.description: Search sources, follow citations, and screen evidence.
literature.reviewsIntro: Open by ID; review listing is unavailable.
literature.confirmCreate: Create review with fixed screening criteria?
literature.question: Research question
literature.savedIntro: Saves the query and sources above. Automatic import is off.
literature.queuedTask: Queued task {{id}}. Follow progress in Tasks.

review.title: Literature review
review.noCandidates: No candidates. Add search results from Literature using this review ID: {{id}}
review.prismaIntro: Server-calculated counts and exclusion reasons. Full decision history is not exposed by the API.
review.confirmDecision: Append this screening decision to the review log?
review.notEligible: Include at title / abstract stage before full-text screening.

experiments.needHypothesis: Enter a hypothesis of at least 3 characters.
experiments.needMetric: Enter at least one metric name.
experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.description: Create a template plan, review its immutable revision, then launch a run.
experiments.noTemplatesBody: Install a reviewed template on the host.
experiments.launchIntro: Supply the hypothesis, metric names, parameters, limits and any dataset, split or search space. The selected template hash is fixed when creating the plan.
experiments.noPlansBody: Choose a template to create your first plan.

plan.title: Experiment plan
plan.heading: {{id}} · revision {{revision}}
plan.sealedIntro: Trial and confirm runs do not authorize test-set access. Final evaluation needs separate approval and is allowed once per plan. The host checks approval and previous successful evaluation before execution.
plan.finalLocked: Final evaluation is already queued, running or completed.
plan.recentOnly: Matches from the latest 100 host tasks; older runs may be omitted.
plan.bundleIntro: One zip with every run of this plan (failed runs included), the plan revisions and approvals, the template source and the dataset manifest. Data are never included: rebuild them from the source.
plan.approveDescription: Approve {{ref}} with content hash {{hash}}. Runs can then execute this plan.
plan.finalDescription: Approve and launch the single final evaluation for {{ref}}, using the displayed parameters and seed. Test results must not guide further tuning.

run.title: Run status
run.noAttemptsBody: Waiting for the worker. Task status above may explain a blocked or failed launch.
run.heading: {{id}} · attempt {{attempt}} · {{state}}
run.noDetectorsBody: An empty result does not establish that all checks passed.

details.noRuns: No runs in recent task history
details.identityConfirmed: Identity confirmed. Confirm final evaluation again to continue.

compare.paramsArray: Parameter specs must be a JSON array of up to 200 objects.
compare.rowInvalid: Supply a metric, split, evidence ID, nonnegative integer index and finite nonnegative tolerance.
compare.title: Reproduce and compare · {{id}}
compare.intro: Map each metric and split to a paper evidence number (zero-based index). Absolute tolerance uses canonical units; relative tolerance is a fraction of the absolute reported value. Percent values become fractions; zero requires exact agreement with relative tolerance.
compare.paramSpecsHint: Each object needs name and evidence_id, plus either number_index (zero-based, optional unit) or text from the quote. Example: [{"name":"batch","evidence_id":"e2","number_index":0}]. Evidence must belong to the same paper version.
compare.evidenceDetails: Comparison evidence, verification and source locations

paired.title: Compare with another run
paired.intro: Same dataset, split, windows and seed; this run is A, the other run is B.

studies.needPlan: Enter a plan ID and a positive integer revision.
studies.title: Studies
studies.description: Pre-register a sweep and inspect its analysis.
studies.studyIdHint: Open an existing study by ID; the host does not provide a study listing.
studies.startIntro: The plan revision must already be approved and define a search space with one to four factors. Creation queues screening runs. Declare chance performance for the shuffled-label control before final evaluation.

study.title: Study results
study.advanceIntro: Advancing checks finished runs and may queue the next sweep stage. Final evaluation requires separate confirmation; the host enforces the single-evaluation gate.
study.finalDescription: Approve final evaluation for {{ref}} and advance this study with its frozen parameters. The test set is evaluated once; do not tune on its results.
study.anovaIntro: Effects apply within this setup. Unreported and inestimable terms are not evidence of absence.
study.noCurvature: Curvature unavailable. This is not evidence of no curvature or an interior optimum.
study.noAnovaBody: Analysis appears when enough valid screening results are available.
study.noRulesBody: This does not establish that every run succeeded.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Why each research choice was made; support is re-checked on every read.

planning.axisFormat: Write each axis as "name: term, term | alternative" ({{line}}).
planning.confirmFeasibility: Check feasibility? Cited questions about the project library go through the model gateway (paid, within the ledger caps).
planning.title: Research planning
planning.description: Feasibility from recorded facts and cited answers; gaps from verified claims. No overall score.
planning.axes: Gap map axes (one or two lines)
planning.axesHint: paradigm: motor imagery, sleep staging | sleep scoring
planning.gapIntro: {{count}} verified claims; a gap means no verified claim in this library, not absence from the literature.

update.title: About / Updates
update.description: Research OS never checks for updates by itself. Check when you want to; installing uses only the downloaded setup (no further network).
update.installingHint: Research OS closes, installs the update silently and starts again. Your data is kept. If setup fails, the current version is restored.
update.readyManual: The installer was downloaded and its checksum verified. Automatic install works only in the installed Windows version; run this file yourself:
update.noAutoCheck: No automatic checks. The installer's sha256 is verified before anything is installed.
update.mirrorHint: A URL prefix put in front of GitHub links, e.g. https://ghfast.top/. Leave empty for a direct connection.

errors.update_network: Could not reach the update server. Check the network or set a mirror.
errors.update_timeout: The update server did not answer in time. Try again or set a mirror.
errors.update_http_error: The update server returned an error. Try again later or set a mirror.
errors.update_bad_metadata: The release information is invalid. Nothing was downloaded or changed.
errors.update_checksum_mismatch: The downloaded installer failed the sha256 check and was deleted. Nothing was changed.
errors.update_bad_mirror: The mirror must be empty or an https:// address ending with /.
errors.update_not_available: Check for updates first; no newer version is known.
errors.update_not_ready: Download and verify the update first.
errors.update_unsupported: Automatic install needs the installed Windows version. Run the downloaded setup yourself.
errors.update_launch_failed: The installer could not be started. The current version is unchanged.
